notes.title: Happy First Anniversary!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, POSTAL Dudes and Does![/b]

Happy April Fools' Day! Today marks a special occasion, and a very important milestone that we never thought we’d reach: the day POOSTALL Royale turns one year old!

We weren’t kidding when we said we’d still work on this and give you updates for free! This is a passion project and we’re in this for the long haul. Expect more updates to come to this little passion project of ours in the future, and hopefully more frequently. We’ve got one in the works already, and we’re hoping it’s a doozy! The list below should give you all an insight into what we’ve been cooking over the past year. 

Thank you all for sticking by us for our first year, and remember: [i]GO POOSTALL![/i]
- The C Team

[h1]What We've Been Cooking:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved and expanded maps and hub area
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43885818/50fd2f2af51fcbe08bef8f341ceb39f63be0934a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43885818/5acf50a5a269247d924044054bb8167fc684c8b1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43885818/259cd3f3e15f3b6fbe1692448ad9a3d0c4c064f6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43885818/a4f9e4fc2fb35b4fe623c01a01d3d9dee812558f.png[/img]
[*] New weapons (two will be added in the next patch, more are still being designed)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43885818/eebcc9c64c4da8f6078b50f5e0a56812695edc46.png[/img]
[*] Selectable costumes (models are still placeholders and subject to change)
[*] Improved HUD functionality
[*] Redesigned UI elements
[*] New announcer lines
[*] Improved Pigeon Mission
[*] New loading screen art for each playable map
[*] New pickup items (food, Kevlar armor)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43885818/7e21c894cc34caa094475e7c34d04becf7fc9620.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43885818/bfadf475e8bb1ba894a0c049c948e614ea99775f.png[/img]
[*] Added song for Credits
[*] New hidden song by Fudge Packard (low chance of playing in Menu and Credits)
[*] "Quit to Desktop" function from the Pause Menu
[*] New playable characters!
[/list]

notes.title: April Fools 2023
notes.content:
That's right, this was all part of an elaborate April Fools joke, but what exactly is real and what isn't?
To put it simply, the game is real, the people who worked in it are real and all the plans to continue improving the game are real too!

While this game was never meant to be taken too seriously, the people behind the "C Team of RWS" are passionate and are willing to continue polishing this game they've worked on for [u][b]only a month[/b][/u]. All the new updates will be [u][b]free to download[/b][/u]!

For those who are wondering what's on the horizon for POOSTALL Royale, we have a roadmap right here which shows some of the plans we're willing to share at the moment: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2362740/discussions/0/5300214375037026550/


For a FAQ and known issues, check out this thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2362740/discussions/0/5300214375036978536/



Thank you all for the overwhelming support, GO POOSTALL!
- The C Team
